That is a deadline-driven lodgement, so the date is very likely real. It was not yet lodged at 16:41 AEST on 29/09/2026 (last item: Appendix 2A at 9:32 am, https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=MKR&timeframe=Y&year=2026). The date is right, but the release probably falls outside the window; see session_check.
session_check: Probably amc, not the vendor's bmo. Manuka's four most recent statutory financial reports were lodged at 16:17 (14/03/2025 interim), 16:30 (30/09/2025 annual), 16:08 (16/03/2026 half-year) and 15:51 (30/09/2024 annual), so three of four came after the 16:00 close. A 30/09/2026 lodgement after 16:00 would fall outside the close(29/09) to close(30/09) window. Sources: ASX archive, 2024-2026 (URLs in event_check).
positioning_check: ASIC aggregate short is 0.0558% (1,000,524 shares) as of 2026-09-23, unchanged from 2026-09-16 (change 0.0 pts). The data is 4 sessions old. This is effectively nobody short: no squeeze fuel and no building short. Run-up is -30.2% over 20 days and -7.7% over 5 days. The stock sits at A$0.060 against the A$0.07 placement: 207m placement shares (about 11.5% of the 1.80bn on issue) are 14% under water, and the SPP raised only A$334k against a A$1m target. That overhang explains the slide and is already in the price. The priced lean of +1.5 comes almost entirely from the run-up component.

A first gold pour or sale announcement since the 21/08/2026 restart (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260821/pdf/073145s3xfbyxb.pdf): none lodged in about 5.5 weeks, against a company target of first gold sales by end of September. Web search for first gold pour or Wonawinta September 2026: only placement coverage (sharecafe, mining.com.au, discoveryalert), nothing newer than 7 Sep.
Going concern and Nebari covenant: FY25 already carried a going-concern material uncertainty. I found no covenant breach or waiver disclosure.
Pipeline Ridge maiden resource ('forthcoming' per the 7 Sep release): no date given, so it cannot be placed in the window.
baseline_tension: Nothing I found cuts for or against the +1.5 lean, which is mostly a mean-reversion prior on the -30% run-up; the run-up is explained by a documented placement overhang that is already public.
